Done. I've implemented all three utility functions:

1. **clamp(n, min, max)** in src/num.js — constrains n to the range [min, max] using Math.max/Math.min
2. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — converts bytes to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, replaces spaces with dashes, and strips non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes)

All are exported from their respective modules.
